policy.integrationRule: A candidate touching a matching hook/RVA or riskPath must revalidate the known crash signature before D integration.

signatures.symptom: Immediate startup access violation inside the canonical SpriteNode queue-entry prologue after installing VRHudQueueSemanticBridge.
signatures.rootCause: SafetyHookMid at RVA 0x2D734 relocates/returns through the short queue-entry prologue; real crashes resumed at offsets 0x2D738 and 0x2D73E inside original instructions.
signatures.fixReference: VR-HUDQUEUE-ENTRY-CRASH-559eb670: remove the 0x2D734 mid-hook and lazily begin semantic queue ownership at the first per-node hook RVA 0x2D762.
signatures.validation: LEVEL0 CI must forbid any production Module::exe_ptr(0x2D734) hook; Win32 build/package plus LEVEL1 HMD startup required.

notes: Crash ZIPs should contain crash_signature.json with exceptionCode, absoluteAddress, moduleBase and exeRva when the fault address belongs to OR2006C2C.EXE.
Exact EXE identity is verified separately by docs/VR_BINARY_CONTRACT.json.
Do not create a new key for a recurrence of the same bounded crash; append evidence to the existing key.
